knowledge.raw_output:
A: Atlantic tidal basin  

**Explanation:**  
The Atlantic Tidal Basin (in Washington, D.C.) is a man‑made body of fresh water created by damming the Potomac River. It functions as a reservoir—storing river flow for use and recreation—and therefore qualifies as a freshwater reservoir among the given options. The other choices are either saline bodies (Atlantic Ocean, Pacific Ocean), frozen ice masses (Antarctic polar ice), or marine environments (Gulf of Mexico).

options.A: least surface area and most direct sunlight
options.B: greatest surface area and most direct sunlight
options.C: least surface area and least direct sunlight
options.D: greatest surface area and least direct sunlight

*Explanation:* Evaporation is driven by two main factors—surface area (more water exposed to air) and heat input (direct sunlight provides the energy needed for phase change).
